For $40,000.00 at 6.53% and AGI $55,000.00: RAP $179.17 a month, $21,830.57 cancelled after 360 payments, total $64,501.20. Tiered Standard (15 years) $349.10 a month, total $62,839.01. 10-year Standard $454.80 a month, total $54,576.48. Lower monthly payment: RAP. Lower total paid: Tiered Standard. Only RAP counts toward PSLF.

General information, not financial or legal advice. Your servicer computes the official payment from your certified income and loan records. Use the StudentAid.gov Loan Simulator to confirm.

tiered_standard.rule: 10 years under $25,000; 15 years $25,000 to under $50,000; 20 years $50,000 to under $100,000; 25 years $100,000 or more (total principal when entering repayment).

standard_10_year.note: Only for borrowers with no Direct Loan made on or after July 1, 2026.

assumptions: Income and dependents stay the same every year; in reality RAP is recalculated each year from new AGI.
Interest is computed monthly at rate/12 on the balance; servicers accrue simple daily interest.
All RAP payments are on time, so the interest subsidy and principal match apply every month.
Balance is treated as one loan pool of Direct Loans eligible for RAP (no Parent PLUS).
structuredContent.regulation_note: The RAP formula, the $10 minimum, the $50-per-dependent reduction, the interest subsidy, the $50 principal match and the 360-payment cancellation are fixed by statute (HEA sec. 455(q), added by P.L. 119-21 sec. 82001(d)). How a servicer rounds, accrues daily interest, applies the subsidy across several loans and treats a mid-year income change is set by Department of Education procedures and regulations, which this server did not confirm as final on 2026-11-02. Treat cents-level results as estimates.
